shots.p: close-up of a merchant's hand secretly pressing on a balance scale in a market stall, cheating, shadowed face
medium shot of the same merchant demanding a full heaping measure of grain when buying from a farmer
medium shot of the same merchant giving short weight to a poor customer, scooping a little back from the scale
close-up on the same merchant counting coins smugly, never thinking of the day of reckoning, candle light
low angle view of an immense solemn sky over a vast plain, a tremendous day
wide shot of countless people standing on a vast plain at dawn, humble and silent before the Lord of the worlds, seen from far
wide shot of a narrow dark underground passage descending into gloom, tight and confining, non-graphic
low angle view of a deep, dark confined pit-like canyon, sense of a grim unknown place
close-up of a sealed inscribed stone tablet in a dark chamber, record decided, no visible letters
wide shot of a dark storm over a town of deniers, lightning flashing
medium shot of men scoffing at the day of reckoning, waving dismissive hands
medium shot of an aggressive sinful man shoving others in a market, arrogant face
medium shot of the same sinful man smirking and calling a recitation old legends, turning away
close-up of a mirror covered over by layers of dark rust and grime, the heart's covering by sins
wide shot of a heavy dark veil hanging over a closed gate, those barred and screened away, grey light
wide shot of a dark valley glowing red at night far away, non-graphic
close-up on a regretful man's face as he is reminded of what he used to deny, dim light
low angle view of a lofty high place above the clouds at sunrise, exalted heights
wide shot of shining mountain heights above the clouds, beyond description
close-up of an honored inscribed tablet glowing softly on a high pedestal, no visible letters
wide shot of a radiant high hall bathed in pure light, honored presence implied, no figures
wide shot of a blissful garden with flowing rivers and canopies at golden hour
close-up of ornate couches under a canopy in a garden, gazing out at a beautiful view
close-up on a face glowing with radiant joy and comfort
close-up of a sealed crystal flask of pure drink with a wax seal on a silver tray
close-up of the seal scented with musk on the flask, inviting, people competing in good deeds implied by a race track toward a lit mosque
wide shot of a spring flowing down from a lofty height into a crystal basin
wide shot of a high pure spring at sunrise in a garden, reserved for the nearest
medium shot of arrogant men laughing at a group of humble believers in a street
medium shot of the same arrogant men winking at each other mockingly as believers pass
medium shot of the same arrogant men returning home jesting and amused, feasting
medium shot of the same men pointing at the believers and calling them misguided
medium shot of the same men sitting as self-appointed judges though no one appointed them guardians
medium shot of the humble believers now smiling with relief and dignity, the mockers' faces downcast
medium shot of the believers reclining on fine couches in a garden, gazing at the beauty around them
close-up of a balance scale with one side heavily weighted down, deeds repaid
